summary: Appeal challenging High Court's dismissal in limine of informant's appeal; reliance on acquittal under Arms Act, 1959, and non-production of ballistic report; SC holds trial evidence must be independently assessed; remand ordered; High Court to decide appeal on merits; procedural failure noted in bypassing trial records; proceedings revived and notice to be issued promptly.
final_judgment: Impugned order set aside; appeal revived; remanded to High Court for decision on merits; original records to be returned and appeal heard expeditiously.
